This game is quite fun, I enjoy the mechanics and other gameplay aspects, although there are tons of issues.
Balancing- All of the characters are horribly balanced, sukuna and gojo are unfairly overpowered, while toji and todo are very underpowered.
Pay to use- early access characters being paid is fine, but immediately releasing one that is 8 dollars even though the moveset is fully complete is utter nonsense.
Glitches- there are an exponential amount of glitches, such as gojo's domain not freezing enemies, sukuna's domain doing no damage, toji's ult refusing to activate, toji's chain grab having a broken pull, aim, and hitbox. There are definitely more glitches, but I am not adding all of them.
Toxicity- There is no voice moderation as of now, which means players are fully allowed to do things such as say slurs towards others, which I have seen in game before.
This game should have been heavily delayed, that is the sad truth, it is unplayable with the state it is currently in.

As a minimod and beta tester, I can say this is a great game. It's been through a lot in testing, and I do love the result it released with. The devs constantly and passionately work to balance moves, work on bugs, and much more. The game has many many players, which comes at a cost. In a public lobby, it is inevitable to avoid toxicity in many forms. While we can't get rid of this problem, all of us, mod or not, can help report and spread kindness in the MS community. I love helping kids play the game, and i also love fighting. The game has offered plenty of content with 4 characters, and the microtransactions are very reasonable. In conclusion, this game is great, but every great game has its flaws. 

- lynn
